title: Bechtel and Monsanto possibly handling alien bodies and biological specimens

tellings.quote: I was also told that Monsanto may have historically been involved, most likely dealing with biological specimens.

plain: Large companies may have handled alien bodies and biological specimens in secure underground sites, with the engineering firm Bechtel and the chemical company Monsanto named in the story. Michels says he was told this, without naming who told him, and that Monsanto may have been involved in the past, most likely dealing with biological specimens.
